notes.title: Fate and Life Translation
notes.content:
So finally, I have completed the translation of Fate and Life: The Mystery of Vaulinhorn into several languages. I used machine translation to translate this game. The issue is that there might be many grammar errors because, as you know, machine translation will never match the level of human translation. Unfortunately, I contacted several translators, and the prices they offered were very expensive (I don't really blame them since my game has 250k words). That's why I decided to use machine translation instead. I guess it’s better than not translating the game at all.

Due to the potential grammar errors, I need your help to proofread the results of the machine translation.
So far, these are the languages I’ve translated into:

French
Italian
Simplified Chinese
Portuguese
Russian
Spanish

If you’re proficient in any of these languages, please help me proofread my machine translation results. You can contact me via DM on my Discord. I will share the machine translation of Chapter 12 (not the latest unreleased version).

I’m not expecting you to fully edit and proofread all the text (though if you want to proofread everything, I would be very happy 😊). I just want you to point out any words or phrases that are wrong in the translation, especially in the sex scenes, as I believe there are likely many mistakes there.

My discord username: celestialnovel

notes.title: 17% Launch Discount and 4k Renders
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I just wanted to let you know that the 17% launch discount is almost over! It will be over in just 2 days, so grab it now while you still can!

Also I want to say thanks for everyone who has bought the game on Steam and leave positive review, it means so much for the development of the game 🙂 Currently, on Steam, the game has 25 positive reviews and 6 negative reviews. 6 negative reviews are kinda problem for Steam's visibility algorithm which results in the decline of the sales, so I hope for you who have bought the game on Steam don't forget to leave positive review.

Despite this, the sales on Steam remain relatively acceptable and as a result, I will buy RTX 4090 next month! With RTX 4090 I can render in 4k and increase SubD level of the renders, from 1 to 5. The attached images depict the difference between rendering in 4K SubD level 5 and Full HD SubD level 1

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516414/7b03dc086d3fcfed2e8978fcb1bcd3a45d4ca4a7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44516414/f6945fbebe4b110e38a307468134fbcae3051182.png[/img]

As you can see in the images, the Full HD render with SubD level 1 tends to have pixelated graphics, which creates unnatural "notches" as shown in the part I've marked with a red circle. However, with 4K resolution and SubD level 5, the notches become natural and no longer pixelated. With my current GPU, rendering at 4K SubD 5 quality takes a very long time, which is why I need the RTX 4090. The money I earn from Steam will allow me to purchase RTX 4090 and many other things to improve the game. So, I kindly request that you don't forget to leave a positive review on Steam if you like the game, thanks 🙂

notes.title: Fate and Life: The Mystery of Vaulinhorn DLC!
notes.content:
The DLC containing Bonus Renders, Gallery Unlocker, and the Ability to Bypass Love/Corruption Requirements is being approved by Steam! Wishlist both the DLC and the main game now! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810240/Fate_and_Life_The_Mystery_of_Vaulinhorn__Bonus_Renders__Gallery_Unlocker__Bypass_LoveCorruption_Requirement/]Click here for the DLC link[/url]

This DLC contains three features: Bonus renders, gallery unlocker and a feature to bypass love/corruption points requirement.

Bonus Renders
It contains 142 new renders that can be found in the 'Bonus renders' folder.
The 'Bonus renders' folder is located in the game folder. To find it, right-click on Fate and Life: The Mystery of Vaulinhorn in your Steam library and select Manage > Browse local files.

Gallery Unlocker
With this DLC, you will find a new 'Gallery Unlocker' feature that will unlock all scenes of the game. You can find it in the replays menu.

Bypass Love/Corruption Points Requirement
With this DLC, you can bypass Love/Corruption points requirement to unlock certain scenes. This feature will automatically appear when a choice requires some love/corruption point.
